title: School Supplies [Kids Vocab] What's in My Bag? 🎒 Pencil, Eraser & Ruler
speaker: English Singsing
zh: 【English Singsing】學習用品 [兒童字彙] 我的包包裡有什麼？ 🎒 鉛筆、橡皮擦和尺子（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: English Singsing school supplies
cues.en: English Singsing school supplies
cues.zh: 英語歌唱學習用品

cues.text: What's in your backpack?
cues.en: What's in your backpack?
cues.zh: 你的揹包裡有什麼？

cues.text: It's my book. I can read.
cues.en: It's my book. I can read.
cues.zh: 這是我的書。我會讀書。

cues.text: book book It's my notebook. I can write on it.
cues.en: book book It's my notebook. I can write on it.
cues.zh: 書 書 這是我的筆記本。我可以在上面寫字。

cues.text: notebook notebook These are my scissors. I can cut the paper.
cues.en: notebook notebook These are my scissors. I can cut the paper.
cues.zh: 筆記本 筆記本 這些是我的剪刀。我可以剪紙。

cues.text: scissors scissors It's my glue. I can stick them with it.
cues.en: scissors scissors It's my glue. I can stick them with it.
cues.zh: 剪刀剪刀這是我的膠水。我可以用它來黏住他們。

cues.text: glue glue It's my tape. I can put them with it.
cues.en: glue glue It's my tape. I can put them with it.
cues.zh: 膠水膠水這是我的膠帶。我可以把它們放在一起。

cues.text: tape tape Is this your pencil case?
cues.en: tape tape Is this your pencil case?
cues.zh: 膠帶 這是你的鉛筆盒嗎？

cues.text: Yes, it is.
cues.en: Yes, it is.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.text: pencil case pencil case What's in your pencil case?
cues.en: pencil case pencil case What's in your pencil case?
cues.zh: 鉛筆盒 鉛筆盒 你的鉛筆盒裡有什麼？

cues.text: These are my pencils and pens. I like to write.
cues.en: These are my pencils and pens. I like to write.
cues.zh: 這些是我的鉛筆和鋼筆。我喜歡寫作。

cues.text: pencil pen
cues.en: pencil pen
cues.zh: 鉛筆鋼筆

cues.text: It's my eraser. I can erase and write again.
cues.en: It's my eraser. I can erase and write again.
cues.zh: 這是我的橡皮擦。我可以擦除並再次寫入。

cues.text: eraser eraser It's my highlighter. I can mark with it.
cues.en: eraser eraser It's my highlighter. I can mark with it.
cues.zh: 橡皮擦 橡皮擦 這是我的螢光筆。我可以用它來標記。

cues.text: highlighter highlighter It is my ruler. I like to measure.
cues.en: highlighter highlighter It is my ruler. I like to measure.
cues.zh: 螢光筆 螢光筆 這是我的尺。我喜歡測量。

cues.text: ruler ruler These are my color pencils. I can draw a rainbow.
cues.en: ruler ruler These are my color pencils. I can draw a rainbow.
cues.zh: 尺 尺 這些是我的色鉛筆。我可以畫彩虹。

cues.text: color pencil color pencil There are things for school in my backpack.
cues.en: color pencil color pencil There are things for school in my backpack.
cues.zh: 色鉛筆 色鉛筆 我的揹包裡有上學的東西。
